Before that: IBM, and trading.  
  
What is OpenBot   
OpenBot is a free, open-source alternative to Grok Bot - a team of AI agents that runs locally on your own computer instead of cloud. Plug in the ChatGPT, Claude, Grok or OpenCode subscription you already have, no extra bill.   
It also has a multiplayer mode, so your whole team can share a project and talk to the same agents together, live.  
  
The problem   
Grok Bot showed where AI is headed - agents that work for you. But it runs on a Linux server in the cloud: plenty of apps just don't work there, websites often flag and block that kind of server traffic outright, it costs $200-300/month on top of what you already pay, and there's no way for a team to actually work with the same agents together.

results.content: OpenBot by CopilotKit is a free, open source Grok Bot alternative: AI coworkers that each get a containerized computer of their own — a dedicated Chromium browser, logins, and workspace — with every tool call evaluated against CEL policy rules (fail-closed) and written to an audit trail, including human take-the-wheel moments. Bring any AG-UI agent: LangGraph, CrewAI, Mastra, Pydantic AI, or Google ADK. Self-host with a single Docker image (embedded Postgres optional) on your own infrastructure. In the comparison we cover xAI's Grok Bot computer-use model factually: one persistent cloud VM per account, sign-in with your own credentials, session reuse across bots, prose-based approvals, and audit logs still to come — versus OpenBot's per-bot isolation and enforced governance.

# OpenBot vs Grok Bot: A Local Grok Bot Alternative

OpenBot is a free, local Grok Bot alternative: run AI agents on your computer with the ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok plan you already pay for. Compare the two.

Checked ·Sources

OpenBotvsGrok Bot

## The short answer

For most people, OpenBot is the better choice: your agents use the AI plans you already pay for, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok, or your own model. They run on your own computer, and the app is free and needs no account. Choose Grok Bot only if you want a cloud computer to run your Bots, so that you keep no computer of your own on.

### Choose OpenBot if

Recommended [...] Why choose OpenBot over Grok Bot?

Your agents use the AI plans you already pay for, such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini or Grok, or your own model. OpenBot keeps your workspaces, chats and files on your own computer, the app is free and works without an account, and its source code is on GitHub. You can reach your agents from your phone too. Grok Bot is the better fit only when you do not want to keep any computer on for your agents.

Can I use my ChatGPT, Claude or Gemini subscription with OpenBot?
